text: {"status":"answered","answer":"For a domestic wire to another bank, send your request by 3:00 p.m. Eastern Time on a business day and it will be processed that same day, under the Wire Transfer Policy (Rev 2026-02). Requests received after 3:00 p.m., or on a non-business day, go out the next business day. If it's an international wire, the cutoff is earlier — 1:00 p.m. Eastern Time — for same-day release.","cited_chunk_ids":["wire_transfer_policy::layout::B_structure::0004"],"reason":"The Wire Transfer Policy specifies same-day cutoff times for domestic and international wires."}
